targets.rawSql: SELECT claim_type, total_claims, unique_beneficiaries, unique_providers, claims_missing_start_date, negative_payment_claims FROM silver_marts.mart_claim_volume ORDER BY claim_type;

SELECT claim_type, total_claims, total_claim_payment_amount, average_claim_payment_amount, minimum_claim_payment_amount, maximum_claim_payment_amount FROM silver_marts.mart_claim_payments ORDER BY claim_type;

SELECT source_system, claim_type, total_claims, unique_beneficiaries, unique_providers, total_claim_payment_amount, average_claim_payment_amount, claims_missing_start_date, negative_payment_claims FROM silver_marts.mart_claims_by_source_system ORDER BY source_system, claim_type;
SELECT feed_date, claim_type, bronze_daily_rows, silver_daily_rows, rejected_rows FROM silver_marts.mart_daily_claim_feed_quality ORDER BY feed_date DESC, claim_type;

panels.title: Top Providers by Total Claim Payment

targets.rawSql: SELECT provider_id, claim_type, total_claims, unique_beneficiaries, total_claim_payment_amount, average_claim_payment_amount, negative_payment_claims FROM silver_marts.mart_provider_performance ORDER BY total_claim_payment_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT pipeline_name, run_id, feed_date, files_processed, total_rows_loaded, successful_files, failed_files, run_status, duration_seconds, started_at, ended_at FROM silver_marts.mart_pipeline_run_audit ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 10;
